rules.description: The recommendations on the start page. Subscriptions, channels, search, playlists and your library are left alone.
rules.notes: The start page is a ytd-browse element marked page-subtype="home". YouTube keeps it in the document, hidden, while other pages are shown.

rules.description: The recommended videos next to the video you are watching. The video, its description and its comments are left alone.
rules.notes: A loading skeleton inside the list has the same id as the list. :has() picks the real one.
